Spear masters of the Sheikah tribe can use the crescent shape to snag their opponents and deliver brutal cuts.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 35 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Serpentine Spear}} Serpentine Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by members of the [[Sheikah]] tribe. Spear masters are able to catch opponents with their crescent shape and deliver brutal cuts. These Spears belong to the [[Sheikah Gear]] equipment archetype, consisting of all Weapons created and utilized by the Sheikah.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} They are found in [[East Necluda]], particularly around [[Kakariko Village]], as well as in [[Hyrule Field]]. Since Serpentine Spears are made of metal, they will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They are also unable to burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. If they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they will sink, but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_037" |Life = 35 |Power = 12 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 32 |BuyingPrice = 130 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * The repeating black, yellow, and red patten on the Serpentine Spear's staff resembles the coloration of a {{Wp|coral snake}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Serpentine Spear Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Serpentine Spear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Sheikah Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Sheikah Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
